environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT, no IGW route). Traffic ingress is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890 interface endpoint with a VPC endpoint policy that restricts the source VPC to vpc-0xdeadbeef. The endpoint policy additionally enforces aws:PrincipalOrgID condition matching o-abc123def4. The NLB target group health check is on /health only. The private hosted zone resolves api.internal.example.com to the VPC endpoint ENI IPs. There is no public DNS record, no internet gateway attached to the VPC, and the subnet route table has only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local). Security group on the ENI allows inbound TCP 443 only from CIDR 10.0.48.0/20 (the consumer application subnet).

config.deployment: ECS Fargate in isolated private subnet
config.network: No IGW, no NAT gateway, no public route in subnet route table
config.dns: api.internal.example.com -> private hosted zone -> VPC endpoint ENIs
config.consumer_restriction: Only services in 10.0.48.0/20 within vpc-0xdeadbeef can reach the endpoint
